o Long Term Strategic Planning Workgroup ("LTSPW"): A periodic recurring meeting / standing
group with participation drawn from across various functions including Resource Planning, Quality
Assurance Office (QAO) Team, Internal Reviewers, Subject-Matter/Discipline Experts, and the
Operational Risk Management department has been formally constituted under the supervision of
the Central Review Board ("CRB") in the prior planning cycle. The purpose of the group is to
review, validate, approve and track progress across all initiatives that have been flagged as high
priority and/or are not aligned with the agreed delivery roadmap of the programme.
